title: What Makes the Cylinder-Shaped N72 Cage Stable?
authors: Hongwei Zhou, Ning-Bew Wong, Ge Zhou, Anmin Tian

species.source_note: Table 1/2 (bond types, lengths for select bonds, orbital energies), text

bond_params.shape: cylinder-shaped cage, ~2.2 nm long, built by systematic layer-insertion procedure (N6(D3h) mother molecule -> insert W-shaped/chair-form hexagon layers alternately -> N12(D3d) -> N18(D3h) -> ... -> N72(D3d)); described as 'a beeline nanotube'. Every atom is 3-coordinate (3x72/2=108 bonds). Select bond lengths: N1-N4 ('55B' type, longest+highest orbital energy), N5-N10 = 1.483 A, N1-N2 ('35B' type, longest).

species.suggested_build: UNKNOWN -- 72-atom cylindrical cage, far beyond current geom.py functions; the paper's own layer-by-layer construction algorithm (starting from N6(D3h), inserting hexagon layers) could in principle be coded but is a substantial undertaking
species.notes: Genuine local minimum reported (lowest vibrational frequency 30 cm-1, i.e. all-real frequencies at B3LYP/cc-pVDZ). Described as 'the largest nitrogen cage investigated until now' at time of publication. No full Cartesian coordinate table found in the extractable text -- only bond-type/length spot values and the procedural construction description. Same category as N60_marek_03.json's cage: far beyond current project scale (max N20), flagged for the appendix D 'extend beyond N12/N20' roadmap item rather than immediate reconstruction.

not_extracted_but_relevant: Paper is primarily an NBO/AIM bonding-analysis study (why cylindrical N-cages are stabilized by intramolecular through-space interactions) rather than a structure-survey paper -- only one species (N72 D3d itself) is the actual subject.
